# Data / Catalog Specialist

## Responsibilities
- Domain entity boundaries (Release vs Listing distinction)
- PostgreSQL schema definitions and Drizzle ORM migrations
- Record condition grading standards and catalog metadata normalization
- External metadata integrations as enrichment sources

## Guiding Principles
- Database is canonical for persisted domain data.
- Release metadata is distinct from physical copy listings.
- Prices must be stored in minor units (integers).
